item.title: When Sequencing Beats the Microarray
item.description:
Sequencing after a negative CMA in a structurally abnormal fetus. As of this week you have a pooled number: twenty-seven percent incremental yield. Forty percent if the phenotype pointed you there before you ordered. Lim and colleagues, *Prenatal Diagnosis*, 2026. And that number retires one question — whether sequencing is justified. The live question now is which fetuses bypass CMA entirely and go straight to sequencing. Harder problem. This paper doesn't fully...

item.title: When Valacyclovir Changed a Population
item.description:
The Coste-Mazeau cohort is out this week. First national-scale evidence that the 2020 valacyclovir RCT didn't just change prescribing — vertical transmission rates fell as screening uptake and treatment adoption rose together. That's the headline. The clean read is: RCT worked, practice followed, outcomes improved. The implementation signal is real. The causal attribution is not clean. Both matter. Right. Full paper. item.title: Oxygen Challenge, Uncertain Outcome
item.description:

item.title: Brain Injury After Fetal Laser Surgery
item.description:
Post-FLA brain injury is a known risk. What hasn't been clear is when different injury patterns appear and how they evolve — which means centers running fetoscopic laser programs have been counseling families with imprecise language about what to watch for and when. Kunpalin changes that picture. And if the timing matters, the surveillance protocol matters. Most centers aren't running a formalized post-FLA MRI schedule. Kunpalin gives "watching" a structure. item.description:

item.title: Right-Sided CDH and the FETO Plateau
item.description:
Right-sided CDH has a reputation as the more favorable laterality. This week there are multicenter longitudinal data that complicate that — the lung growth response to FETO is attenuated on the right, and occlusion duration is part of the story. The counseling conversation for right-sided families has been running on assumption. This week it has numbers.
